summary: AI/ML Engineer with 2+ years of production experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications. Specialized in fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA/QLoRA, designing advanced RAG & agentic systems, and delivering low-latency inference APIs using LangChain, Groq, FastAPI, Docker, and MLflow. Hands-on expertise in computer vision, 3D reconstruction and multilingual retrieval pipelines (FAISS, Milvus), along with voice enabled systems. Proven track record of shipping scalable AI solutions end-to-end, from custom model training and pretrained model integration to production deployment and monitoring.
